title: IDL: improving a SolidWorks workflow
summary: As a Design Engineer at IDL Worldwide, I worked with the team to reduce store-drawing turnaround from eight hours to two hours, then personally reduced it to 37 minutes.

hero.title: IDL: improving a SolidWorks workflow
hero.subtitle: Improving the connections between tools, information, and people.
hero.summary: At IDL Worldwide, I worked on store drawings for a nationwide Apple fixture rollout at AT&T retail locations. I combined my understanding of SolidWorks with coworkers’ shortcuts, collaborated across the team to encode information more efficiently for quicker handoffs, and streamlined QC. Sharing discoveries helped deepen cooperation as we improved the process.

overview.title: Store drawings for a national retail rollout
overview.description: At IDL Worldwide, I digitized more than 500 AT&T retail locations in SolidWorks to support Apple fixture installations. Store-drawing turnaround was initially eight hours.

media.alt: Store drawings and fixture elevations spread across a desk: plan views, exploded assemblies and a rendered store layout
media.title: Store drawings for the AT&T rollout

solution.title: Improve the workflow, then keep refining it
solution.description: I brought together software efficiencies, shortcuts learned from coworkers, better information preparation across the team, and a streamlined QC process. Sharing discoveries helped us improve the way we worked together. Drawing turnaround fell from eight hours to two hours with the team. I subsequently refined my own workflow to 37 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare information
steps.description: Collaborated with other parts of the team to encode information more efficiently and support quicker handoffs.

steps.title: Produce drawings
steps.description: Combined my understanding of SolidWorks and its time-saving features with shortcuts learned from coworkers.

steps.title: Hand work over
steps.description: Improved how information moved between people, beyond the drawing task at my own desk.

steps.title: Check quality
steps.description: Streamlined QC as part of the broader workflow improvement.

steps.title: Share discoveries
steps.description: Shared what I discovered and learned from colleagues, supporting deeper cooperation.

impact.title: Drawing turnaround and delivery scope
impact.description: The two-hour result belongs to the team. The later 37-minute result describes my individual workflow. The figures reflect the combined improvements, not separately measured savings for each change. Financial savings, stress reduction, and worker autonomy were not measured here.

conclusion.title: What this work contributes
conclusion.description: This is professional design-engineering experience in improving a complex production workflow. It informs how I approach repeated tasks, handoffs, and the effort required to move work forward.
